WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) cnt 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_store_sk IN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County')
      AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk IN (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential IN ('1001-5000', '5001-10000') AND hd_vehicle_count > 0)
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
filtered_customer AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag 
    FROM customer 
    WHERE c_customer_sk IN (SELECT ss_customer_sk FROM filtered_store_sales WHERE cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
)
SELECT f.c_last_name, f.c_first_name, f.c_salutation, f.c_preferred_cust_flag, dj.ss_ticket_number, dj.cnt
FROM filtered_customer f
JOIN filtered_store_sales dj ON f.c_customer_sk = dj.ss_customer_sk
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, f.c_last_name ASC
